inclusions.text: Private boat trip, operated for your party alone
inclusions.source: This is a private boat trip, operated for your party alone — never shared with strangers.
The boat is crewed, a snorkelling guide is in the water with you at each site, and one bottle of mineral water per person is included.

inclusions.text: Snorkelling guide in the water with you at each site
inclusions.source: The boat is crewed, a snorkelling guide is in the water with you at each site, and one bottle of mineral water per person is included.

inclusions.text: One bottle of mineral water per person
inclusions.source: The boat is crewed, a snorkelling guide is in the water with you at each site, and one bottle of mineral water per person is included.
It is suitable for children who can swim confidently — under-18s are welcome with a parent or guardian, and life jackets are carried on board; it is not suitable for non-swimmers.

inclusions.text: Pickup from your Hurghada hotel and transfer to the marina
inclusions.source: The day begins with a pickup from your Hurghada hotel and a short transfer to the marina.

inclusions.text: Transfer from the marina back to your hotel
inclusions.source: The return crossing follows in the early-to-mid afternoon, and a transfer from the marina brings you back to your hotel.

exclusions.text: Water sports for hire, including kayaks and paddleboards
exclusions.source: A range of water sports are typically available for hire independently, including kayaks and paddleboards, though these are not included in the trip price.
The Mahmya environmental fee is paid on site; we can build it into the briefing so no one is surprised.
